# Bharti Airtel Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent on Bharti Airtel Limited research; Foundation-specific statutory filings (CSR1, Trust registration number, PAN, standalone income/expenditure statement) were not located within remaining budget. give.do and LinkedIn/Facebook/Instagram profiles for the Foundation were held sources and could not be read; a Scribd-hosted 'Bharti Airtel Foundation Annual Report 2023-24' was also held and unreadable.

Bharti Airtel Foundation (formerly 'Bharti Foundation') is confirmed as a Trust, philanthropic arm of Bharti Enterprises (the group holding company, not Bharti Airtel Limited specifically), set up in 2000, and itself Section 135-CSR-eligible as an implementing entity. It runs the Satya Bharti School Program, Quality Support Program (QSP) with QSP State Partnerships, higher-education collaborations with IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay and ISB Mohali, and an employee payroll-giving scheme called ACT. Cumulative self-reported impact-since-inception figures were found (4.3 million+ students, 3.62 lakh+ teachers, 37,000+ schools, 25,000+ villages, 7.8 million+ total beneficiaries) though the website's 'data as of' date (31 March 2026) is itself likely a forward-dated site artifact and is flagged rather than corrected. No statutory identifiers (CIN/PAN/reg_no/CSR1), no year-by-year CSR spend, and no standalone financial figures for the Foundation were found; note that a prior lookup of 'Bharti Foundation' in the catalog surfaced only a fuzzy-name false positive (SBI Foundation, an unrelated organisation) confirming Bharti Foundation/Bharti Airtel Foundation is genuinely absent from the catalog rather than merged under another name.

## What it set out to find

- identity (name, funder_type, parent_name, section_135_bound, website)
- identifiers (cin, pan, csr1, darpan, reg_no, domain)
- csr_year (not applicable to a trust that is not itself Section-135-obligated in the same way as a company)
- csr_spend (own project-level spend, if separately disclosed)
- footprint / stated_geography
- partners / higher-education collaborators
- programs (Satya Bharti School Program, QSP, etc.)
- grants made / received
- metrics (cumulative impact figures)
- contacts
- documents
